paragraphs.text: Mica is a Lorehold student, artificer , and geomancer, at Strixhaven University on the plane of Arcavios . He demonstrates an exceptional affinity for stone and earth, with minimal aptitude for spiritual magic, and exhibits limited social engagement, often focusing exclusively on physical surroundings and geological phenomena rather than talking with fellow students or professors.

Mica is a buff human Lorehold mage-student. He lacks skill in the spiritual side of Lorehold magic, which he compensates for through his mastery of geomancy. Among his peers, he is widely regarded as the foremost source of knowledge on the physical history of Arcavios; students seeking insight into the land itself often turn to him, though his depth of knowledge can be overwhelming. Mica’s interests lie in the most ancient and tangible layers of history, approaching the past through fossils, mineral formations, and sedimentary records rather than spirits or echoes. He frequently travels across the plane collecting geological samples, and at times employs his magic to draw forth faint, incomplete manifestations of ancient presences lingering within stone.

In the fall semester of his second year in 4565 AR , during the expedition to the Fields of Strife , Mica was assigned by Augusta Tullus to accompany Quintorius Kand to investigate a newly discovered subterranean artifact cache. He navigated the ghost -infested terrain with minimal interference, using geomancy to traverse safely and later to examine the site. Upon discovering signs of disturbance and the intruder Stella Lee 's presence, he focused on the geological history of the chamber, ultimately uncovering fossilized footprints embedded in the stone, confirming the presence of an unknown ancient entity linked to Quintorius's broader investigation. He then assisted in documenting the site and its findings.
